# ZOHEN Charger

> ZOHEN Charger (Anhui Zuoheng International Trade Co.,Ltd.) is an OEM EV charging manufacturer in Anhui, China. The company builds and exports AC charging stations (7-44 kW), DC fast charging stations (20-400 kW), portable EV chargers (3.5-40 kW), and EV adapters and connectors covering CCS1, CCS2, GB/T, NACS, CHAdeMO, Type 1 and Type 2 standards. Buyers are distributors, fleet operators, charging network operators, installers and project teams in Europe, the Middle East, South America and Southeast Asia. All commercial terms are quotation-based; the site is not a checkout store.

Canonical domain: https://zohencar.online
Content language: English (en)
Sales contact: sales@zohencar.online | WhatsApp +86 172 0180 7491
Company: Anhui Zuoheng International Trade Co.,Ltd., No. 188 Automotive High-Tech Industrial Park, Anhui, China
Facility: 25,000 m2 manufacturing site, 78 staff, 30+ R&D engineers, 200+ active SKUs, founded 2010
Certifications: IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, CE, UL 2251, RoHS, FCC, IP54-IP67
Commercial terms: OEM/ODM available; MOQ, pricing, lead time and samples confirmed by quotation

## Product Categories

- AC Charging: 7-44 kW wallbox and floor-standing AC chargers for home, workplace and light commercial use, with Type 1, Type 2 and GB/T connectors and optional WiFi, APP, RFID and OCPP connectivity.
- DC Charging: 20-400 kW wall-mounted and floor-standing DC fast charging stations, single or dual gun, with CCS1, CCS2, GB/T, CHAdeMO and NACS connector options.
- Portable: 3.5-40 kW portable AC and DC chargers for roadside rescue, dealerships, temporary sites and backup charging.
- Adapter: CCS, GB/T, NACS, CHAdeMO, Type 1 and Type 2 adapters, connectors and V2L accessories.
